title: Surreal Entertainment
content: I’ve seen a lot of surreal entertainment, one night was a live show with what looked like hologram dancers / actors. Lots of bright colors on a black stage, with rows of black audience chairs. It was a small venue, dark, and nearby were food stands and a bar. I spoke with the guy who “made” the show, he goes every night and his name was Travis. I met him in the hotel. He showed me his other inventions, some special knives, and a device that made sense in the dream, but when I woke up I couldn’t remember its purpose. Later on in the dream I went up a flight of stairs (maybe an elevator?) and was in the mall for the first time. My vision is ‘slippery’ there, like I’ll end up on the floor, standing, sitting, moving around almost like I’ve been drugged.
